scope: Active normalized CSV event review at 0.1 second sample intervals
bridge_rule: Merge adjacent qualifying-window unions only when the gap is at most 0.5 seconds, all intervening speed samples are non-increasing, endpoint speed drops by at least 0.01 m/s, and source/grid quality passes. Apply transitively in time order to every case.
duration_rule: end_time minus start_time; do not add one sample period
usage: Application event definition. Source integrity and continuity are checked against the import registry; collection authenticity remains a provider declaration.
